scope: v10 changed code against the spec and the v09 camera recorder evidence: sightPose math (Python and C++), native front post and camera integration, pedestal collision and sweep verification, release gates, tests that cannot fail, user docs. Three passes: review (0 Critical, 2 Important, 10 Minor), re-verification of the fixes (M5 not applied; N1-N3 Minor), final check. No engine execution.

resolved_findings.summary: The 35 u pedestal box stops walking but a jump clears it; operating from its top (dz +35 <= 64) was never sampled and the docs claimed it still stops the player.
resolved_findings.fix: verify_sight_path builds operator feet by raycasting walkable collision inside the native acceptance (186 positions, 52 on the pedestal top) and requires pedestal positions; docs state the jumpable pedestal as a visual-only limit.

resolved_findings.summary: PRUEBAS step 5 expected "a few cm" high at 10 and 30 m; the 75 m zero gives ~28 cm high at 30 m.
resolved_findings.fix: Predicted offsets stated: +3 cm at 10 m, +28 cm at 30 m, ~32 cm near 40 m, 0 at 75 m, -66 cm at 100 m.

resolved_findings.summary: Camera clearance and sight-line checks skipped the fixed base and the front arch.
resolved_findings.fix: All visual meshes except ring and post mesh; separate >= 15 u near-plane check for the sight meshes and a zero near-plane-cut check inside the view; renders at clip 15.

resolved_findings.summary: Collinearity compared the pose with itself.
resolved_findings.fix: Post node written as Plugin.cpp writes it (pitch-local R^T(F-T)/s); ring centre and post apex measured on the written meshes.

resolved_findings.summary: Sweep clearance was sampled and the docs claimed every pose.
resolved_findings.fix: 1-Lipschitz guaranteed lower bound with refinement; +38 deg added; docs say sampled every 15 deg and >= 30 vs the pedestal by construction.

resolved_findings.summary: Model scale also scaled the ballistic zero.
resolved_findings.fix: Zero range and drop unscaled in Core.cpp and sight_pose.py; geometry scales.

resolved_findings.summary: Dead v08 zero functions and the never-running post-camera hook counted as evidence.
resolved_findings.fix: Marked legacy; test asserts Plugin.cpp does not call them; status reports the hook as never observed running. Hook kept installed (removal untestable without the game).

resolved_findings.summary: Python and C++ shared golden values only for flat fire.
resolved_findings.fix: Golden values at 0/45/80 deg in both suites; Python returns None on degenerate input like C++.

resolved_findings.summary: Sight-path evidence tied only to NIF hashes; test used the report threshold.
resolved_findings.fix: inputs_sha256 for sight_pose.py, verify_sight_path.py, config.json gated in package_release; fixed thresholds in test and gate.

resolved_findings.summary: Stair reference gate stopped checking the pedestal footprint.
resolved_findings.fix: Pedestal min and max x/y must equal the reference in verify_stair_route and package_release.
Reworded post movement, cause, test step 4 and in-game caveat.

resolved_findings.summary: Re-verification: the package status key post_camera_world_anchor_implemented had not actually been replaced.
resolved_findings.fix: Replaced by post_camera_hook (never ran in the v09 log) and v08_sight_zero_functions (legacy).

resolved_findings.summary: Re-verification: the near-plane check tested only vertices and triangle centres; a large face could cross the clipped slice unseen.
resolved_findings.fix: Triangle overlap with the clipped view pyramid plus the vertex test; falsified in the same run with a crossing face and with the ring against a 20 u plane.

resolved_findings.summary: Re-verification: the verified operator area (160 u, |dz| 64) was hard-coded in the verifier, not tied to the enforcing code.
resolved_findings.fix: Test ties the verifier radius and |dz|, and (final check) its crank centre and the operator height, to the written OperatorNode, the final ESP VMAD, the PSC defaults and Plugin.cpp.

resolved_findings.summary: Re-verification: tower visual-only meshes are outside the camera, near-plane and sight-line checks.
resolved_findings.fix: Documented as scope in the verifier and its report (not_covered).

accepted_limits: Engine model: sphere radius (12-15 u) and its start at the eye are fitted to the v09 log, not measured in the engine.
Jumping onto the 35 u pedestal puts the player inside the base (visual only; the sight works and is verified from there).
The base has no collision above 35 u: arrows and spells pass through the shaft and legs.
At +80 deg the rear ring is 16.5 u from the camera: an fNearDistance above ~16 (INI/ENB) clips it.
Outside the sight the front post keeps its last native position (up to 3.9 u) until the 3D reloads.
The camera is hundreds of units from the player head: engine side effects (audio listener, LOD) unverified.
M10 (plausible only): rear stem to drawn string clearance (~4.6 u in y) comes from source bounds, not verified through Fire/Reset.
Sight picture changes with elevation by design (ring apparent radius 2.6 to 21.6 deg).
Tower visual-only meshes are not in the camera/near-plane/sight-line checks (N3, documented scope).
Python sightPose does not reject a NaN right axis (C++ does); production inputs are finite node transforms.
open_issue_not_a_finding: The tail camera and the iron-sight zero are verified on geometry and models only; the in-game test is pending.
